info.title: cantoria
info.description: Sheet music archive for choirs: catalog, rights, scores, concerts

get.description: One row per copy (shelf mark), in the order of the shelf. All filters are optional and combine. Internal preservation copies are left out for roles that may not view them.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in shelf mark, title, composer, arranger or work number (case-insensitive, also parts of words)

parameters.name: shelfmark
parameters.description: Exact shelf mark, e.g. "5-1" (also finds "5-01")

parameters.name: binder
parameters.description: Number of the binder

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the copy

parameters.name: rights_status
parameters.description: Rights status of the version; "none" for versions without one

parameters.name: confirmed
parameters.description: Whether the archive management has confirmed the rights status

parameters.name: repertoire_class
parameters.description: Repertoire class of the work

parameters.name: has_musicxml
parameters.description: Whether the copy has a MusicXML file

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The "next_cursor" of the page before; omit it for the first page

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: A filter value, the limit or the cursor is not valid

403.description: The account has no role in the music archive

404.description: The interface for agents is switched off

401.description: Current user is not logged in

parameters.name: voice

parameters.name: verse

parameters.name: note

post.description: One proposal per field, all or none. Only fields the catalog librarian may write can be proposed (GET /api/v1/modules lists them); rights confirmations, licenses and the valid version never. Nothing changes until the catalog librarian accepts a proposal in the app. Allowed for the roles contributor and librarian.

level.description: Level of the catalog the fields belong to: "work", "version" or "copy"

object_id.description: ID of the work, version or copy (see "work_id" and "version_id" of a copy)

fields.description: Field => proposed value; null proposes to empty the field

source.description: Where it comes from, e.g. the name of a tool or a transcription round (at most 255 characters)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The level is unknown, there are no fields, or a field cannot be proposed

403.description: The roles of the account may not propose changes

404.description: The work, version or copy does not exist, or the proposals inbox or the interface for agents is switched off

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Review of the transcription of a copy
get.description: The reports of transcriptions read for the copy, newest first and without the received text: the first one with "superseded_by" null gives the current review state (origin, review, reasoning). Then the number of review points per status and the review points themselves in pages, in the order they were created, each with its place in the score, the responsible role and its status. Deciding them stays with the conductor and the catalog librarian in the app.

parameters.description: ID of the copy

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only review points with this status

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only review points of this responsible role

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Review points per page

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The "next_cursor" of the page before; omit it for the first page

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

403.description: The account has no role, or the copy is an internal preservation copy it may not view

get.description: The review points decided as "correct": what the tool chain has to change in the MusicXML ("correction"), oldest first, with copy, report base name, the MusicXML file and its checksum, and the place in the score. The tool chain delivers the corrected MusicXML as a new file through the file sync and closes an order with its next report (the order "id" in "erledigt"). Orders of internal preservation copies are left out for roles that may not view them.

parameters.description: Only the orders of this copy

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Orders per page

parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

post.summary: Hand in the report of a transcription
post.description: The report (format bericht/1, as written by the transcription, e.g. bericht.json) of a transcription of this copy; its "signatur" must be the shelf mark of the copy. The app checks it strictly, keeps it unchanged as evidence and reads it once: uncertain readings, omitted marks, material findings and questions become review points for the conductor or the catalog librarian, rights and catalog fields become proposals; the catalog itself never changes. The same report again creates nothing (200, "unchanged": true). Allowed for the roles contributor and librarian.

content.description: The report as JSON text (the content of bericht.json, at most 1 MB); send this or "report"

report.description: The report as a JSON object, instead of "content"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the copy the report is about

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

201.description: Report read; review points and proposals created

200.description: The same report was read for this copy before; nothing created

400.description: The report is not valid, names another shelf mark, or comes both or neither as text and object

403.description: The roles of the account may not hand in reports, or the copy is an internal preservation copy it may not view

404.description: The copy does not exist, or the review of transcriptions or the interface for agents is switched off

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Revisions of the version of a copy
get.description: Every revision of the MusicXML of the version the copy belongs to, oldest first: its number, where it came from ("first" when the recording started, "correction" in the app, "sync" from the file sync), the file and its checksum, the measures and voices changed, a note and the changes of a correction. "current" marks the revision the catalog librarian has set as current, with the day since when. Comparing two revisions is done on the two files.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the copy

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

403.description: The account has no role, or the copy is an internal preservation copy it may not view

404.description: The copy does not exist, or the revisions or the interface for agents are switched off

401.description: Current user is not logged in

tags.name: page
tags.description: The app page. Accounts with an archive role (or admin rights) get the music archive. Choir members without an archive role get only the page "Shared with me" (milestone 0.7), while the module member_links is on; everyone else is refused.

tags.name: api_v1_catalog
tags.description: Reading the catalog: search, one copy with its version and work, text references (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md). The catalog belongs to the core; these routes only need the interface for agents. Internal preservation copies are left out for roles that may not view them.

tags.name: api_v1_concert
tags.description: Concerts and song lists with their programmes, read only (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md). Planning stays with the conductor and the catalog librarian in the app.

tags.name: api_v1_proposal
tags.description: Proposals: create them and read the own ones (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md). A proposal changes nothing; the catalog librarian accepts or rejects it in the app (guideline 6).

tags.name: api_v1_review
tags.description: Review of transcriptions (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md): read the review of a copy and the correction orders, hand in the report of a transcription (format bericht/1). Deciding review points and saving corrections stay with people in the app: the conductor and the catalog librarian decide, the tool chain delivers a corrected MusicXML as a new file through the file sync. Internal preservation copies are left out for roles that may not view them, as in the other routes.

tags.name: api_v1_state
tags.description: Revisions of a version (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md): read only. Setting the current revision stays with the catalog librarian in the app (guideline 1). Internal preservation copies are left out for roles that may not view them, as in the other routes.

tags.name: api_v1_statistics
tags.description: Statistics, read only (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md): figures without personal data of choir members and without account names.

tags.name: api_v1_status
tags.description: What the interface for agents offers the calling account: version, roles, active modules and permissions (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md).

tags.name: api_v1_task
tags.description: The due list of the own roles, questions and tasks: read, ask, answer (API v1, see docs/api-v1.md). Who may ask and answer is decided by TaskService, as in the app; closing a task stays with people in the app.
